verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted chat platform, not purely an agent, so publishing an official MCP server for external agents is a fair question. All the MCP evidence is client-side: LibreChat connects to and consumes third-party MCP servers. The probe pointing to the MCP docs page leads to that same client-side page, and nothing shows LibreChat exposing its own MCP server endpoint for other agents to connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
